editorial.blurb: Majestic brings passionate, flavorful halal cooking to the neighborhood with care-driven preparation and generous portions.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the mutton biryani and rumali roti—the roti is handmade and worth the wait, though ask for it wrapped in foil to keep it soft longer.
